name: LT2 paired demos and selected timestep controls
comparison_policy: Same initial materials, geometry, chemical laws, temperature, duration and reaction interval within each pair. Only Langevin gamma0.1,m1 differs. Fine controls halve dt while preserving reaction and observation intervals. Existing illustrative seeds, no robustness claim from single-seed microdemos. No extra tool or gene; integrated membrane prepared, V8 molecules initially isolated.

scenario.name: LT2_binary_copy_brownian
scenario.description: Un polymere prepare recrute des monomeres. Un cycle externe libere les produits. La copie initiale est exclue des comptes.
